title: 21. Projects: ML Model Serving Platform (capstone design)
summary: Design and build an end-to-end ML model serving platform like MLflow + SageMaker.
objectives: Build the ML Model Serving Platform (capstone design) projects end to end
Keep a short README with assumptions and tradeoffs

sections.title: Project Overview
sections.body:
Design and build an end-to-end ML model serving platform like MLflow + SageMaker.

**You will build:**

1. Model Registry & Versioning
2. Feature Store with real-time + batch features
3. Model Serving API with A/B testing
4. Training Pipeline orchestration
5. Monitoring & Data Drift Detection (PySpark)
